# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** Around eleven years old at the beginning of the series, turning fourteen to fifteen by the end of Volume 2.  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v2 c28 P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008), [v2 c30 P6](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolgirl  <sub>[v1 c15 P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is an attractive girl with rosy cheeks, dark eyes, and shiny black hair. She has a plump figure that she occasionally worries about, wishing she were more slender. She is recognized among her peers for her excellent taste in clothing and her stylish appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c19 P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034), [v1 c33 P10](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0010), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, pragmatic, and affectionate, often laughing before she speaks. While she enjoys romantic stories and creative play, she maintains a practical outlook on life and sometimes finds highly imaginative concepts puzzling. She is deeply loyal to her friends, dutiful toward her strict mother, and possessive of her personal belongings and space.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c21 P19](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0019)_

## History

Isolde grows up on her family's farm at Pear Hill in Brierley. After Nell Harcourt moves to nearby Grey Shutters, the two girls meet in the Pembroke garden and swear an oath of solemn, lifelong friendship over a path they pretend is flowing water. They establish a playhouse named Larkrise in a nearby birch grove and share games, books, and imaginative names for local landmarks. After Nell accidentally serves Isolde homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, Isolde's mother briefly forbids her from playing with Nell, but the ban is lifted after Nell successfully treats Isolde's younger sister Posy Fay for a severe case of croup. Later, Isolde attends a local concert and sleeps over with Nell at Pear Hill, where their playful jump onto the spare-room bed startles their visiting great-aunt Lavinia; despite initial anger, Aunt Lavinia is charmed by Nell and agrees to fund music lessons for Isolde. As the years pass, Isolde attends Brierley school alongside Nell, participating in the story-writing club, the Brierley Village Improvement Society, and school performances. Though she does not pursue high school entrance exams at Regent's Academy like Nell, Isolde remains her closest confidante and provides steadfast emotional support. Eventually, Isolde becomes engaged to Gideon Duckett, with plans to marry once they reach adulthood.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P22](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0022), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c19 P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), [v1 c19 P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P22](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0022)_

- Raised on the Pear Hill farm in Brierley by strict parents  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>

## Quotes

> I solemnly swear to remain loyal to my bosom friend, Isolde Pembroke, for as long as the sun and moon endure.  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035)</sub>

> Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> Most certainly I shall, and no other intimate friend will ever be mine . . . it is not my desire to possess one. Loving anyone else as deeply as I love you is impossible for me.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>
